summary: Verified fix for the Master Admin sidebar 'Pulse Fitness Portal' bug. Both backend and frontend confirm the switch now impersonates the Pulse Fitness Ltd operator company (is_operator_company=true, id 3ece2d0c-57ea-4acd-a6b4-d748478ed117) instead of the master admin's own 'Pulse Fitness AI Admin' platform org.

results.test_operator_portal_login_as_master_adm: PASS — 200, organization_id=3ece2d0c-57ea-4acd-a6b4-d748478ed117, organization_name='Pulse Fitness Ltd', area='operator', JWT payload organization_id matches and impersonated_by=admin@pulsefitness.com

frontend_tests.pulse_portal_switch: PASS — Clicked 'Pulse Fitness Portal' as master admin. Redirected to /dashboard?impersonation_token=… which further redirected to /pulse. Impersonation banner shows 'Impersonation Session Active — You are viewing as portal@pulsefitness.ltd. Every action is logged.' Brand header shows 'Pulse Fitness Pro · Pulse Fitness AI Head Office' (site subtitle expected per agent note). NOT landing on 'Pulse Fitness AI Admin' platform org.
frontend_tests.global_dashboard_regression: PASS — 'Global Dashboard' sidebar button navigates to /dashboard?as=global; shows the Global Dashboard with 'Pulse Fitness AI Admin' brand (master admin's platform org), no impersonation banner. Unaffected by the fix.

critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint correctly guarded by require_master_admin and queries db.organizations {is_operator_company:true} — clean.
Frontend falls back to /dashboard?as=operator on axios error which is a safe legacy path.
Impersonation JWT issued via shared _issue_org_portal_token with audit logging — matches org portal login pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar 'Pulse Fitness Portal' now POSTs /api/master-admin/operator-portal-login and impersonates the operator company (Pulse Fitness Ltd, portal@pulsefitness.ltd). The URL after redirect resolves to /pulse (operator portal shell), NOT /dashboard — the app internally redirects from /dashboard?impersonation_token to /pulse. Site subtitle 'Pulse Fitness AI Head Office' is a SITE label within Pulse Fitness Ltd org and is EXPECTED per main agent note.
